Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Retrospective: Framing of the VdK Christmas Party

October 29, 2025 · Pfarrheim Goßmannsdorf

On November 29, 2025, the recorder ensemble of the Collegium Musicum Iuvenale (led by Astrid Eitschberger) together with the brass group St. Andreas (led by Alois Klüpfel) musically framed the Advent celebration of the VdK Ochsenfurt in the festively decorated parish hall Goßmannsdorf. The ten-year-old Nina Eisenhauer set a special accent with her solo on the saxophone; her mother accompanied her on the piano. Recorder sounds from the Renaissance period and the warm sound of Alois Klüpfel's brass quintet alternated, framing the speeches and stories presented. It was an afternoon full of contemplative moments that also marked the end of an era: after an impressive 32 years of voluntary service, Mr. Helmuth Gerbig bid farewell as local association chairman. We sincerely thank VdK Ochsenfurt for the invitation and look forward to further joint performances!
